newsitem.title: USA: U.S. beef, hog plants closed Memorial Day.
newsitem.headline: U.S. beef, hog plants closed Memorial Day.

text.p: Major U.S. beef and pork plants will be closed May 26 in observance of Memorial Day, company officials said.

Officials from IBP Inc, Excel Corp, a division of Cargill Inc ; Smithfield Foods and subsidiary John Morrell and Co; ConAgra Inc subsidiaries Swift and Co (pork) and Monfort (beef), along with Hormel Foods Corp and Farmland Industries all said cattle and hog slaughter and processing plants would be closed.
There still could be a few thousand hogs and cattle slaughtered at small specialty plants, a few sources said.
There were 7,000 cattle and 2,000 hogs slaughtered last year on Memorial Day, USDA statistics showed.
